text: How does the card zone know a call really comes from ecom?
prefix: How does the card zone know a call really comes from ecom?

text: Picture a request that simply says, in its header: I am ecom.
prefix: Picture a request that simply says, in its header: I am ecom.

text: Anyone can type that line.
prefix: Anyone can type that line.

text: A name you write yourself is like a name badge made at home: it proves nothing.
prefix: A name you write yourself is like a name badge made at home: it proves nothing.

text: Now picture the staff entrance of an office building.
prefix: Now picture the staff entrance of an office building.

text: You show an ID card, issued by the building's own pass office.
prefix: You show an ID card, issued by the building's own pass office.

text: Reception gives you a day pass, and the pass lists the floors you may visit.
prefix: Reception gives you a day pass, and the pass lists the floors you may visit.

text: The lift goes only to those floors.
prefix: The lift goes only to those floors.

text: The card zone works the same way for every call: two proofs, from two places, and a list of floors.
prefix: The card zone works the same way for every call: two proofs, from two places, and a list of floors.

text: The first proof is a certificate: a digital ID card, signed by the card zone's own pass office.
prefix: The first proof is a certificate: a digital ID card, signed by the card zone's own pass office.

text: When a caller connects, it shows its certificate.
prefix: When a caller connects, it shows its certificate.

text: The card zone shows its own certificate back.
prefix: The card zone shows its own certificate back.

text: So each side knows who is on the other end.
prefix: So each side knows who is on the other end.

text: Because both sides show one, this is called mutual TLS.
prefix: Because both sides show one, this is called mutual TLS.

text: If a caller has no certificate from the card zone's pass office, the connection is refused before any request is even read.
prefix: If a caller has no certificate from the card zone's pass office, the connection is refused before any request is even read.

text: The second proof is an access token.
prefix: The second proof is an access token.

text: Here, an access token is a day pass.
prefix: Here, an access token is a day pass.

text: The caller asks for it from the card zone's own login server, using its own secret.
prefix: The caller asks for it from the card zone's own login server, using its own secret.

text: The card zone trusts only that login server.
prefix: The card zone trusts only that login server.

text: A pass from another product's login server is worth nothing here.
prefix: A pass from another product's login server is worth nothing here.

text: Inside the access token is who it belongs to, and its roles.
prefix: Inside the access token is who it belongs to, and its roles.

text: A role is a floor you may visit: one kind of operation.
prefix: A role is a floor you may visit: one kind of operation.

text: One role lets a caller bind a card.
prefix: One role lets a caller bind a card.

text: Another lets it read a card.
prefix: Another lets it read a card.

text: Another lets it charge a card.
prefix: Another lets it charge a card.

text: Every operation needs its own role, and anything not listed is refused.
prefix: Every operation needs its own role, and anything not listed is refused.

text: So even the real ecom can only do what its roles allow.
prefix: So even the real ecom can only do what its roles allow.

text: No caller at all holds the role for the card zone's admin operations.
prefix: No caller at all holds the role for the card zone's admin operations.

text: Now watch the product.
prefix: Now watch the product.

text: These checks have no screen, so watch how the system behaves.
prefix: These checks have no screen, so watch how the system behaves.

text: A caller with no certificate knocks on the partner door.
prefix: A caller with no certificate knocks on the partner door.

text: The connection closes at once.
prefix: The connection closes at once.

text: No request is read, and nothing is answered.
prefix: No request is read, and nothing is answered.

text: Next, a caller brings a valid certificate, but a pass from the wrong login server.
prefix: Next, a caller brings a valid certificate, but a pass from the wrong login server.

text: The card zone answers: unauthorized.
prefix: The card zone answers: unauthorized.

text: The pass did not come from its own login server, so it counts for nothing.
prefix: The pass did not come from its own login server, so it counts for nothing.

text: Now the real ecom calls, with both proofs.
prefix: Now the real ecom calls, with both proofs.

text: It asks to charge a card by its token.
prefix: It asks to charge a card by its token.

text: Its pass carries the role to charge, so the call goes through.
prefix: Its pass carries the role to charge, so the call goes through.

text: Then ecom asks for an admin operation, one that searches cards.
prefix: Then ecom asks for an admin operation, one that searches cards.

text: Both proofs pass.
prefix: Both proofs pass.

text: But ecom's pass has no admin role, so the card zone answers: forbidden.
prefix: But ecom's pass has no admin role, so the card zone answers: forbidden.

text: Three refusals, for three different reasons.
prefix: Three refusals, for three different reasons.

text: No certificate means no connection.
prefix: No certificate means no connection.

text: A bad pass means unauthorized.
prefix: A bad pass means unauthorized.

text: A missing role means forbidden.
prefix: A missing role means forbidden.

text: Each answer tells the operator exactly which check stopped the call.
prefix: Each answer tells the operator exactly which check stopped the call.

text: The card zone keeps its own pass office and its own login server.
prefix: The card zone keeps its own pass office and its own login server.

text: Neither is shared with ecom, so nothing outside the room can hand out the room's passes.
prefix: Neither is shared with ecom, so nothing outside the room can hand out the room's passes.

text: What does this protect?
prefix: What does this protect?

text: Steal only the certificate, and you have no pass.
prefix: Steal only the certificate, and you have no pass.

text: Steal only the pass, and you cannot even connect.
prefix: Steal only the pass, and you cannot even connect.

text: Steal both from ecom, and you still reach only ecom's floors, never the admin floor.
prefix: Steal both from ecom, and you still reach only ecom's floors, never the admin floor.

text: And a mistake inside ecom cannot give ecom more power, because only the card zone grants the roles.
prefix: And a mistake inside ecom cannot give ecom more power, because only the card zone grants the roles.

text: This protects every card in the room, and the bank's trust that only its chosen callers can touch them.
prefix: This protects every card in the room, and the bank's trust that only its chosen callers can touch them.

text: Back to the staff entrance.
prefix: Back to the staff entrance.

text: An ID card from the building's own office, a day pass, and only your floors.
prefix: An ID card from the building's own office, a day pass, and only your floors.
